source.redistribution: Only derived pregame aggregates are published; raw parquet files are not vendored

methodology.feature_timing: Snapshot emitted before target game is applied to state
methodology.player_minutes: Prior appearances only; recent minutes decayed and discounted after missed team games
methodology.availability: Inferred only; DNPs and official historical pregame injury designations are absent
methodology.impact: Conservative proxy from prior on-court net rating, true shooting and usage; not EPM/RAPM
